news.title: OpenAI sets new behavioral guidelines for AI models that have already proven hard to control
news.summary: OpenAI has updated its Model Spec, restructuring its AI behavior guidelines around five core values, including faithfulness to human intent and correctability.

news.title: Zest’s new AI agent finds restaurants and books reservations over text
news.summary: Can't agree on where to eat? Zest's AI concierge can combine everyone's tastes, put restaurant options to a vote, and make the reservation.

news.title: DoorDash said it’s only received ‘several hundred’ orders from AI agents
news.summary: DoorDash said that it is open to working with third-party agent makers.

news.title: A Claude model autonomously chose a gene therapy and operated on a mouse brain with no human decision-making
news.summary: An AI agent performed brain surgery on an epileptic mouse, picking the drug, the brain target, and the injection coordinates on its own.

news.title: Google's AI Mode doesn't drive traffic "for anybody," Reddit CEO Huffman warns the entire web
news.summary: Reddit lost over one million Google search referrals per week in October, CEO Steve Huffman said. The stock dropped more than 25 percent despite strong earnings.

news.title: Ollie, a privacy-focused AI assistant, is shutting down
news.summary: As an increasing number of AI assistants flood the market, the founder of Ollie, an assistant that respected its users' privacy, says it will be shutting down in a week.

news.title: Intel’s stock crashes, knocking $12B from government’s stake
news.summary: Intel is being hurt by PC sales as the AI industry gobbles memory and other components causing PC prices to rise.

news.title: Last-minute Halloween costumes for tech nerds
news.summary: No Halloween costume? Just be a deceptively cute AI agent icon, a PHP vulnerability, or sleepy time Bryan Johnson.

news.title: Cracks are emerging in the AI spending boom
news.summary: Big Tech is pouring billions into AI infrastructure, but mounting debt, negative cash flow, and growing investor skepticism are raising questions about the sustainability of the AI spending boom.

news.title: Theranos whistleblower Tyler Shultz warns that the AI boom is ‘a great opportunity to go deceive people’
news.summary: The cautionary Theranos tale takes on a new significance in the AI era, when companies that have never turned a profit are raising capital at trillion-dollar valuations.

news.title: Can AI data centers be mass-produced like cars? This startup aims to find out
news.summary: Runware is building a factory to turn out prefabricated AI data centers on an assembly line. The real test will be whether it can deliver at that scale.

news.title: You don’t need to believe in a god to get a religious exemption from using AI at work
news.summary: David Durman, a University of Kentucky administrator, recently earned a religious exemption from using AI in the workplace.
